headline: Severe Clashes Shake Weathered Expanse And Nevish Line
war_summary: Fierce fighting has surged along the northern front lines, where Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line have each logged nine strategic base transitions over the past two hours amid rapidly accelerating casualty rates. Linn of Mercy continues as a severe bloodbath, consuming over five thousand casualties across both armies in the two-hour window while recording five fresh base events centered on Lathair and Outwich Ranch. In contrast, Mooring County has quieted following earlier skirmishes around The Wind Hills, recording no strategic flips in the latest two hours. Stonecradle similarly remains static without new base captures despite sustained localized engagements. Across the broader map, Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow, and Stlican Shelf report steady attritional fire without altering the territorial line, while the deep rearward zones remain entirely dormant.
